title: Quietly Umami Chinese Tofu Tagine
description: A satvik-friendly Chinese dish featuring sweet peppadew peppers and bouncy qq tofu, cooked in a tagine style with rich umami flavors, perfect for a brunch mood.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until lightly browned.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced peppadew peppers and cook until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and tagine spice mix, then pour the mixture over the tofu and peppers.
Add the water to the tagine, cover, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the chopped scallions and sesame seeds.
Serve the Quietly Umami Chinese Tofu Tagine hot, garnished with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
